articles.headline: Broadcom (AVGO) Stock Price Today
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Broadcom shares rose 3.82% on November 27 to close at $312.34 following an Anthropic rally, though the chipmaker still ended the week down 9.90% and sits 35.14% below its June 2 peak of $481.57. About 17 million shares were traded in Friday's shortened session. Anthropic's prospectus outlines $161.2 billion in five-year chip rents, with $63 billion financed through a special purpose vehicle, turning Broadcom's private-placement stake into a gain. Meanwhile, Alphabet reportedly plans to trim 2027 shipments of Broadcom-designed AI chips by 20%, despite third-quarter AI chip revenue jumping 221% to $16.7 billion. HSBC's Alastair Pinder remains overweight U. S. equities on a 17% S&P 500 earnings growth forecast for 2027 while warning that higher bond yields could prolong tech weakness.
articles.summary_zh: 博通股价在11月27日上涨3.82%至$312.34收盘，此前Anthropic迎来反弹，但该芯片制造商本周仍下跌9.90%，较6月2日$481.57的一年高点下跌35.14%。 在周五的缩短交易时段中，大约有1,700万股易手。 Anthropic的招股说明书列出了总计$161.2 billion的五年期芯片租金，其中$63 billion通过银行主导的特殊目的实体进行融资，使博通的私募股权投资从账面亏损转为盈利。 同时，据报道Alphabet计划将2027年博通设计的AI芯片出货量削减约20%，尽管第三季度AI芯片收入飙升221%至$16.7 billion。 汇丰的阿拉斯泰尔·平德对美股保持增持立场，预计2027年标普500指数盈利将增长17%，同时汇丰警告称更高的债券收益率可能会延长科技股的弱势。

articles.headline: Micron Share Price Surges 7.6% in Afternoon Trading as Memory Stocks Rally
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Micron Technology shares surged 7.60% to $646.95 in Friday afternoon trading following an Nvidia and Kioxia storage demonstration, though the stock remains down 30.75% over the past month and 46.69% below its June 25 peak of $1,213.56. Kioxia and Nvidia placed 144 Kioxia XD8 solid-state drives into an Nvidia GB200 NVL72 system to create about 1.1 petabytes of raw capacity without releasing performance figures. SanDisk shares jumped 12.85% to $83.07 in morning trading. HSBC's Alastair Pinder remains overweight U. S. equities based on expected 2027 S&P 500 earnings per share growth of 17%, while HSBC warned of risks from higher bond yields and persistent inflation. In high-bandwidth memory competition, China's Huawei is developing a proprietary memory chip with 4,096 data pins, double the HBM4 industry standard of 2,048 pins, with a technical presentation planned for February 2027.
articles.summary_zh: 美光科技公司股价在周五下午交易中飙升7.60%至$646.95，此前英伟达与铠侠的存储演示引发了存储股的上涨，尽管该股在过去一个月仍下跌30.75%，较6月25日$1,213.56的峰值下跌46.69%。 铠侠和英伟达将144个铠侠XD8固态硬盘放入英伟达GB200 NVL72系统中以扩展图形处理器内存，创造了约1.1 petabytes的原始容量，但未提供性能数据。 闪迪股价在早盘交易中跃升12.85%至$83.07。 汇丰的阿拉斯泰尔·平德基于华尔街预计2027年标普500指数每股收益增长17%继续增持美股，而汇丰警告称债券收益率上升和持续通胀构成了风险。 在长期高带宽内存竞争中，中国的华为正在开发一款拥有4,096个数据引脚的专有内存芯片，是HBM4行业标准2,048个引脚的两倍，并计划于2027年2月进行技术展示。

articles.headline: Dow Jumps 591 Points as Black Friday Shopping Season Lifts Stocks; Nasdaq Surges 6.7% for the Week
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: On November 27, the Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 591.99 points to close at 50,774.94 in a shortened trading session following Thanksgiving, marking its fourth consecutive session of gains. The Nasdaq Composite rebounded 543.70 points to 24,129.50 and the S&P 500 closed at 7,297.49, up 114.71 points. On a weekly basis, the Dow gained 5.5%, the S&P 500 rose 5.6%, and the Nasdaq climbed 6.7%. Black Friday shopping season lifted consumer-related stocks like Amazon, while high-tech and semiconductor shares also rebounded, with Nvidia rising 0.80% to $150.49 and Anthropic surging 10.98% to $91.88. Apple shares rose to $358.54, pushing its market capitalization to $5.21 trillion. The CBOE Volatility Index plunged 11.16% to 23.81. Markets remain weighed down by monthly losses, expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes, and reactions to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stepping down on November 12 and returning on November 23.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日感恩节后的缩短交易日中，道琼斯工业平均指数上涨591.99点，收于50,774.94点，创下连续第四个交易日上涨。 纳斯达克综合指数反弹543.70点至24,129.50点，标普500指数收于7,297.49点，上涨114.71点。 从周线来看，道指上涨5.5%，标普500指数上涨5.6%，纳指攀升6.7%。 黑色星期五购物季提振了亚马逊等消费类股票，高科技和半导体股票也出现反弹，其中英伟达上涨0.80%至$150.49，Anthropic飙升10.98%至$91.88。 苹果股价上涨至$358.54，市值膨胀至$5.21 trillion。 芝加哥期权交易所波动率指数暴跌11.16%至23.81。 市场仍受本月跌幅、美联储加息预期以及英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋11月12日卸任和11月23日回归的影响。

articles.headline: Dow Gains Nearly 600 Points in Half-Day US Session for Biggest Weekly Gain Since October 2022; Tech Stocks Surge, Anthropic Jumps Nearly 11%
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: U. S. stocks closed broadly higher on Friday, November 27, in a shortened post-Thanksgiving session, with the Dow rising 1.18% to 50,774.94, posting its largest weekly gain since October 2022 at 5.46%. The Nasdaq gained 2.31% to 24,129.50 for a weekly surge of 6.68%, and the S&P 500 rose 1.60% to 7,297.49 for a 5.60% weekly rise. Anthropic rose nearly 11% to $91.88 after revamping backend systems, reducing median Claude Code wait times by 20% while cutting CPU usage by about 70% and memory usage by over 80% from early 2024 to fall 2026. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index rose 4.69% to 9,186.71, with memory stocks leading. Goldman Sachs projected 2027 DRAM and NAND supply deficits at 5.1% and 2.2%. Nvidia reportedly paused AI server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia following new U. S. export controls, and CEO Jensen Huang prepared for U. S. congressional inquiries.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日周五感恩节后的缩短交易日中，美国股市普遍收高，道指上涨1.18%至50,774.94点，创下自2022年10月以来的最大单周涨幅，达5.46%。 纳指上涨2.31%至24,129.50点，周涨幅达6.68%；标普500指数上涨1.60%至7,297.49点，周涨幅为5.60%。 Anthropic在改造后端系统后上涨近11%至$91.88，使得Claude Code用户的中位等待时间减少了约20%，同时从2024年初到2026年秋季将CPU使用率降低了约70%，每个请求的内存使用量降低了80%以上。 费城半导体指数上涨4.69%至9,186.71点，存储股领涨。 高盛预计2027年DRAM和NAND的供应短缺率分别为5.1%和2.2%。 据报道，在新的美国出口管制出台后，英伟达暂停了向马来西亚、新加坡、泰国和印度的AI服务器发货，同时首席执行官黄仁勋正准备接受美国国会质询。

articles.headline: U.S. Stock Market Today, November 27, 2026: Tech Rebounds in Shortened Black Friday Session
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: U. S. stocks rebounded on Friday, November 27, in a shortened post-Thanksgiving session with the Dow opening up 0.55% at 50,458.86, the S&P 500 gaining 1.11% to 7,262.61, and the Nasdaq adding 1.58% to 23,958.46 before gains pared. Treasury yields increased, with the 2-year yield rising 2 basis points to 4.66%, the 10-year gaining 3 basis points to 4.89%, and the 30-year adding 4 basis points to 5.29%. Oil prices headed for a weekly gain as supply concerns arose from attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy infrastructure, with Brent near $96.60 a barrel and WTI around $85.32. Spot gold traded near $3,649.60 an ounce, up $84.10, and silver traded near $43.64, up about $2.23, driven by a softer U. S. dollar, Chinese physical demand, and equity sentiment. Bitcoin traded near $62,000, while Solana, XRP, and Ethereum also saw gains.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日周五感恩节后的缩短交易日中美国股市反弹，开盘时道指上涨0.55%至50,458.86点，标普500指数上涨1.11%至7,262.61点，纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.58%至23,958.46点，随后涨幅有所收窄。 美国国债收益率上升，2年期收益率上升2个基点至4.66%，10年期收益率上升3个基点至4.89%，30年期收益率上升4个基点至5.29%。 由于霍尔木兹海峡油轮袭击和沙特能源基础设施受袭引发供应担忧，油价有望录得周涨幅，其中布伦特原油在每桶$96.60附近，WTI原油在$85.32左右。 受美元走软、中国实物需求以及股市情绪推动，现货黄金交易价格接近每盎司$3,649.60，上涨$84.10，白银交易价格接近$43.64，上涨约$2.23。 比特币交易价格接近$62,000，同时Solana、XRP和以太坊也录得涨幅。

articles.headline: Broadcom Inc Stock (AVGO) Moved Up by 3.26% on Nov 27: A Full Analysis
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Broadcom Inc (AVGO) stock moved up by 3.26% on Nov 27, outperforming the Technology Equipment sector which rose 1.51%. The advance was propelled by strength across the semiconductor and AI infrastructure complex, driven by institutional enthusiasm for custom ASICs and networking solutions like advanced Ethernet switches and optical interconnects. Segment execution in infrastructure software, particularly VMware integration and monetization into recurring subscriptions, supported margins and cash flow stability. The company reported latest annual revenue of $63.89B and net profit of $23.13B, ranking 5th in the industry for both. Analysts have an average price target of $516.73 with a high of $663.00 and low of $215.88. Company-specific risks include potential order cuts up to 20% from Alphabet for custom TPU accelerators, $43 billion in lease backstop obligations for Anthropic's compute infrastructure, high customer concentration where the top five customers generate about 55% of consolidated sales, and gross margin dilution from an unfavorable product mix shift toward custom ASIC assemblies.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日，博通公司（AVGO）股价上涨3.26%，跑赢上涨1.51%的技术设备板块。 上涨动力来自半导体和人工智能基础设施领域的广泛强势，特别是机构对定制专用集成电路（ASIC）以及先进以太网交换机和光互连等网络解决方案的热情。 基础设施软件部门的持续执行，特别是VMware的整合与货币化带来的经常性订阅模式，支持了利润率和现金流稳定。 公司最新年营收为$63.89B，净利润为$23.13B，两项指标均在行业排名第5。 分析师给出的平均目标价为$516.73，最高为$663.00，最低为$215.88。 公司特定风险包括来自关键锚定客户Alphabet可能高达20%的定制TPU加速器订单削减与重新分配、Anthropic计算基础设施高达$43 billion的租赁保底义务、前五大客户创造约55%合并销售额的高度客户集中度，以及向高组件和内存成本的定制ASIC组件组合转变导致的毛利率稀释。

articles.headline: Are Wall Street Analysts Bullish on Jack Henry & Associates Stock?
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. (JKHY) has a market cap of $12.7 billion and provides integrated technology solutions to approximately 7,200 clients, including banks and credit unions. Over the past 52 weeks, JKHY stock has risen 5.3%, lagging behind the broader S&P 500 Index's 6.1% return and the State Street Financial Select Sector SPDR ETF's 7.8% rise. Following its Q1 2027 results on November 3, shares climbed 10.8% due to adjusted revenue rising 7% year-over-year to a record $682.18 million, total revenue increasing 9%, and EPS reaching $2.28. The company also saw a 102-basis-point expansion in adjusted operating margin to 28%, 9 competitive core wins, 11% cloud services revenue growth, and 93% recurring revenue. For fiscal 2027, the company raised its EPS guidance to $7.47 - $7.51, increased revenue growth guidance to 6% - 6.8%, and raised expected deconversion revenue to $30 million. For the fiscal year ending in June 2027, analysts expect EPS to grow 6% year-over-year to $7.40. Among 22 analysts covering the stock, the consensus rating is a 'Moderate Buy' based on 13 'Strong Buy' ratings, two 'Moderate Buys', six 'Holds', and one 'Strong Sell'.
articles.summary_zh: Jack Henry & Associates, Inc. （JKHY）市值为$12.7 billion，向大约7,200家银行和信用社客户提供综合技术解决方案。 过去52周中，JKHY股价上涨了5.3%，落后于标普500指数6.1%的回报率以及State Street金融精选行业SPDR ETF 7.8%的涨幅。 在11月3日发布2027财年第一季度业绩后，由于调整后营收同比增长7%达到创纪录的$682.18 million、总营收增长9%以及每股收益（EPS）达到$2.28，股价攀升了10.8%。 公司调整后营业利润率扩大102个基点至28%，获得9个竞争性核心业务胜利，云服务营收增长11%，且经常性收入占93%。 对于2027财年，公司将EPS指引上调至$7.47 - $7.51，将营收增长指引上调至6% - 6.8%，并将预计解约转换营收提高到$30 million。 对于截至2027年6月的财年，分析师预计EPS将同比增长6%至$7.40。 在覆盖该股票的22位分析师中，一致评级为“温和买入”，具体包括13个“强力买入”、2个“温和买入”、6个“持有”和1个“强力卖出”。

articles.headline: US tech stocks rebound as chipmakers recover from sharp selloff
articles.section: 美国股市 / US Market
articles.summary: US technology stocks rebounded on Friday, November 27, during a shortened Black Friday trading session, recovering losses from earlier in the week as investors returned to AI-linked stocks. Anthropic rose 3.5%, Meta Platforms gained 3%, SpaceX advanced 2.5%, Amazon and Microsoft climbed 1.9%, and Alphabet added 1.4%. The Nasdaq composite jumped about 1.1% at the opening bell, and the Cboe Volatility Index (VIX) fell over 8% to 24.60. Both the NYSE and Nasdaq closed at 1 pm local time. Nvidia shares fell 1.6% following reports that its Blackwell chips were found at a Shanghai data center linked to Alice Huang. The rebound followed a volatile week where Nvidia surged over 31% on Monday after reinstating co-founder Jensen Huang as CEO, before dropping nearly 6% on Tuesday as the Nasdaq fell 1.5% and Anthropic closed below its $83 initial public offering price. Across the semiconductor sector, Micron Technology rose 5.2%, Advanced Micro Devices gained 4.7%, Broadcom advanced 3.1%, TSMC climbed 2.8%, and Intel gained approximately 5.2% in premarket trading.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日周五，在缩短的黑色星期五交易时段中，美国科技股反弹，收复了本周早些时候的部分跌幅，投资者重新买入与人工智能相关的股票。 Anthropic上涨3.5%，Meta Platforms上涨3%，SpaceX上涨2.5%，亚马逊和微软均上涨1.9%，谷歌母公司Alphabet上涨1.4%。 纳斯达克综合指数开盘跳涨约1.1%，Cboe波动率指数（VIX）下跌超过8%至24.60。 纽约证券交易所和纳斯达克均于当地时间下午1点收盘。 英伟达股价下跌1.6%，此前有媒体报道称其先进的Blackwell芯片在与Alice Huang有关联的上海数据中心被发现。 在此次反弹之前，本周市场波动剧烈，英伟达在周一宣布恢复联合创始人黄仁勋担任首席执行官后暴涨超过31%，但在周二因纳斯达克下跌1.5%且Anthropic收盘跌破$83首次公开募股价格而回吐近6%。 在整个半导体板块中，美光科技上涨5.2%，超威半导体上涨4.7%，博通上涨3.1%，台积电美股上涨2.8%，英特尔在盘前交易中上涨约5.2%有关。

articles.headline: 決算発表直後に上昇したTOPIX100構成銘柄は？ 株価騰落率TOP20（2026年9-11月発表分） 野村證券・滝沢弘量
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: Nomura Securities analyzed the stock price change rates of TOPIX100 constituents that announced earnings between September 10, 2026, and November 19, 2026. The top 5 companies by price change rate on the earnings announcement day and the following day were Toyota Motor (7203) in 1st place, Resonac Holdings (4004) in 2nd place, Oriental Land (4661) in 3rd place, Lasertec (6920) in 4th place, and Mitsubishi Corporation (8058) in 5th place. According to Nomura analyst Hirokazu Takizawa, Toyota's results showed top-line sluggishness and raw material price hikes acting as earnings weights; Resonac's upward revision was viewed positively due to ongoing portfolio reforms; Oriental Land's results met expectations; Lasertec's announcement of an upward revision to its full-year order plan at an unexpected time was viewed positively; and Mitsubishi Corporation's large-scale share buyback announcement was received favorably. By sector, electrical equipment had the most representations in the top 20, including Lasertec, Advantest (6857), Panasonic Holdings (6752), and Tokyo Electron (8035). Nomura noted that despite US mid-term election DC construction regulation strengthening and US-China friction concerns, AI-related investment shows no slowdown.
articles.summary_zh: 野村证券对2026年9月10日至2026年11月19日期间公布财报的TOPIX100成分股的股价变动率进行了排名分析。 根据财报公布当日及次日的股价变化率，排名前五的公司依次为：第1名丰田汽车（7203）、第2名レゾナック・ホールディングス（4004）、第3名东方乐园（4661）、第4名Lasertec（6920）以及第5名三菱商事（8058）。 据野村证券分析师滝沢弘量解读，丰田业绩受到顶线增长乏力和原材料价格高涨的拖累；レゾナック的业绩大幅上修因业务组合改革推进而受到正面评价；东方乐园业绩符合预期；Lasertec在意外时机上修全年订单计划被认为呈积极印象；三菱商事的大规模股票回购发布获得了好印象。 从行业来看，电气设备行业在前20名中入围最多，包括Lasertec、爱德万测试（6857）、松下控股（6752）和东京电子（8035）。 野村指出，尽管存在美国中期选举后的数据中心建设监管强化和中美贸易摩擦再燃等担忧，但AI相关投资并未出现减速迹象。

articles.headline: 日経平均、1211円高の5万8711円 AI・半導体株主導で2日続伸
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: On November 27, the Nikkei Stock Average rose significantly for the second consecutive day, closing up 1,211.95 yen or 2.11% at 58,711.11 yen on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The Tokyo Price Index (TOPIX) also ended 64.80 points or 1.73% higher at 3,815.20. Support came from prior European stock gains, US stock index futures rises, and Korean market gains. Although trading started slightly lower due to a lack of clear cues from the Thanksgiving holiday closure in the US, overseas speculators increased risk tolerance and made intermittent purchases of Nikkei futures by mid-morning, steadily expanding gains. In the afternoon, artificial intelligence and semiconductor-related stocks drove the market higher, with the market's gains expanding to roughly 1.8 times the pre-noon increase of 672 yen by the close. While the rise to the upper 58,000 yen range highlights high-range price action and short-term volatility risks driven by speculative futures buying, market participants are watching for the post-holiday reaction in US markets.
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日，东京股市日系平均指数大幅连续第二日上涨，收盘较前一日上涨1,211日元95钱（2.11%），报58,711日元11钱。 东证股价指数（TOPIX）也上涨64.80点（1.73%），收于3,815.20点。 前一日欧洲股市走高、美国股指期货上涨以及韩国股市上涨提供了买盘支撑。 由于美国感恩节休市缺乏明显线索，早盘一度小幅下跌，但从前场中段开始，风险承受能力提高的海外投机资金对日经平均期货进行间断性买入，相场单方面扩大涨幅。 午后由人工智能和半导体相关股票主导进一步走高，大引け（收盘）时的涨幅扩大至前场上涨672日元的约1.8倍。 日经平均指数回升至5万8000日元后半段，令市场开始警惕高位震荡，海外投机客的期货主导买盘也放大了短期波动，市场声音正密切关注节后美国市场的动向。

articles.headline: アルファパーチェス Research Memo：利益予想を据え置き、株価は年初来安値から持ち直し（1）
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: アルファパーチェスは11月13日に2026年12月期第3四半期決算を発表した。 売上高は前年同期比8.0%増の46,242百万円、営業利益は同0.3%増の1,035百万円となった。 前期にアスクルの出荷・仕入停止の影響を受けたが概ね回復している。 MRO事業は売上高35,009百万円、セグメント利益859百万円となり、主要顧客の大企業向けは堅調だったがアスクル経由の中小事業所向けはランサムウェア被害の影響が残り前年を下回った。 営業リソース増強による人件費増も利益を押し下げた。 一方、FM事業は売上高11,215百万円、セグメント利益121百万円となり、インバウンド需要の堅調や建設コスト上昇に伴う改装需要の高さから増益を確保した。 通期の連結業績予想は、売上高65,300百万円、営業利益1,650百万円で据え置いたが、セグメント別ではMRO事業の予想を引き下げ、FM事業の予想を引き上げた。
articles.summary_zh: 阿尔法采购于11月13日公布了2026年12月期第3季度财报。 营业收入为46,242百万日元，同比增长8.0%，营业利润为1,035百万日元，同比增长0.3%。 前期受到母公司兼客户ASKUL暂停出货和进货的影响，目前大致正在恢复。 MRO业务营业收入为35,009百万日元，部门利润为859百万日元，主要客户大企业面向表现坚挺，但经由ASKUL的中小事务所面向仍受勒受勒索软件被害影响低于去年，且营业资源增强带来的人事费用增加压低了利润。 另一方面，FM业务营业收入为11,215百万日元，部门利润为121百万日元，受益于访日需求坚挺以及建设成本上升导致的改造需求高涨，确保了增益。 全年合并业绩预期维持营业收入65,300百万日元、营业利润1,650百万日元不变，但在分部预期中下调了MRO业务，上调了FM业务。

articles.headline: レーティング日報【最上位を継続＋目標株価を増額】 (11月27日)(株探ニュース)
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 11月27日に調査機関が投資判断を最上位で継続し、目標株価を引き上げた銘柄として、マツキヨココディファイン＆カンパニー（大和、3500→3600円）、GLP投資法人（東海東京、17.03万→17.47万円）、武田薬品工業（みずほ、7400→9050円）、ホシザキ（UBS、7620→7950円）、ベイカレント（GS、9240→14600円）、ハピネット（東海東京、6770→7360円）、バンダイナムコホールディングス（JPモル、6500→9200円）、フジシールインターナショナル（東海東京、3700→3800円）、兼松（みずほ、2800→3900円）、SOMPOホールディングス（岩井コスモ、7600→8400円）、南海電気鉄道（岩井コスモ、3500→3600円）がまとめられた。
articles.summary_zh: 11月27日，汇总了调查机构维持最高投资评级并上调目标股价的股票。 对象包括松本清HD（大和，3500→3600日元）、GLP投资法人（东海东京，17.03万→17.47万日元）、武田药品（瑞穗，7400→9050日元）、星崎（瑞银，7620→7950日元）、BayCurrent（高盛，9240→14600日元）、Happinet（东海东京，6770→7360日元）、万代南梦宫HD（摩根大通，6500→9200日元）、富士Seal（东海东京，3700→3800日元）、兼松（瑞穗，2800→3900日元）、SOMPO控股（岩井日星，7600→8400日元）以及南海电气铁道（岩井日星，3500→3600日元）。

articles.headline: 日経平均寄与度ランキング（大引け）〜日経平均は大幅続伸、アドバンテストや東エレクが2銘柄で約555円分押し上げ
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 27日大引け時点の日経平均株価は前日比1211.95円高の58711.11円となり大幅続伸した。 前日休場だった米国の流れや欧州市場の主要株価指数大幅高を受け、170.63円高で取引を開始した。 寄り付き後はAI投資の採算性や日銀追加利上げへの警戒感から一時下落したが、国内長期金利の落ち着きや中間配当金再投資への期待、米株価指数先物や韓国株の上昇を追い風にAI・半導体関連株を中心に買いが広がり、58000円台を回復した。 東証プライム市場の売買高は24億189万株、売買代金は7兆7872億円だった。 値上がり寄与度トップはアドバンテストで1銘柄で約378円押し上げ、東エレクなどが続いた。 一方、値下がり寄与度トップはリクルートHDとなった。
articles.summary_zh: 27日收盘时的日经平均指数较前一日大幅续涨1211.95元，报58711.11日元。 受前一日休市的美股及欧洲市场主要股价指数大幅上涨影响，以上涨170.63日元开盘。 开盘后虽因AI投资的收益性及对日本央行追加加息的警惕感一度转跌，但在国内长期金利趋于平静、中间分红再投资的期待以及美股指期货与韩国股市上涨的推动下，以AI及半导体相关股票为中心的买盘扩大，收复了58000点大关。 东证Prime市场的成交量为24亿189万股，成交额为7兆7872亿日元。 涨幅贡献居首的是爱德万测试，单只股票将日经平均推高约378日元，东京电子等紧随其后。 另一方面，跌幅贡献居首的是瑞可利控股。

articles.headline: 【米国株】目標株価コンセンサスからの乖離率が大きく、業績見通しも崩れていない銘柄例
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 米国の主要企業による決算が概ね一巡し、S＆P500種構成企業の96.4％にあたる500社中482社の公表時点で、売上高は前年同期比14.62％増、1株あたり利益成長率は同32.65％増となった。 市場予想に対するサプライズは売上高が2.50％、EPSは5.45％のポジティブとなった。 一方で市場ではデータセンター開発規制、米政権による半導体輸出規制、クラウド関連企業の資金調達環境などの懸念材料も意識されている。 こうしたなか、S＆P500に含まれ、アナリストカバー数が15人以上かつ買い推奨比率80％以上、目標株価コンセンサスと直近株価の乖離率が+20-+50％以内、予想売上高・EPSの修正率がともにプラスの条件に基づき、アリスタネットワークス、アンフェノール、テイクツー・インタラクティブ・ソフトウェアなどの銘柄が挙げられている。
articles.summary_zh: 美国主要企业财报大致告一段落，在标普500指数成份股中96.4%（500家中的482家）已公布的阶段，营业收入同比增长14.62%，每股收益增长率为32.65%。 相对于市场预期的惊喜度方面，营业收入为2.50%，EPS为5.45%的正向惊喜。 另一方面，市场也意识到了数据中心开发监管、美政府半导体出口管制、云服务相关企业资金筹措环境等多个担忧因素。 在此背景下，根据包含于标普500中、分析师覆盖人数在15人以上且买入建议比例在80%以上、分析师目标价共识与最近股价乖离率在+20至+50%以内、近3个月内预期营收与EPS修正率皆为正数的条件，列出了Arista Networks、安费诺、Take-Two Interactive Software等股票。

articles.headline: 【テクニカル】日経平均株価テクニカル分析－11/24高値を上回る
articles.section: 日本株式市場 / Japan Market
articles.summary: 日経平均株価は続伸した。 買い先行から一時はマイナス圏に入る場面もあったが底堅く推移し上値を伸ばす展開となり、終値で10日移動平均線の58643円を上回るほぼ高値引けの陽線を形成した。 RSI（9日）は34.2％から39.3％に上昇し、5日移動平均線の57660円や11月24日の終値ベースの戻り高値である58644円を上回った。 来週は11月9日からの自律反発のような動きに期待する一方、10月上旬の高値からの値幅調整は継続しており、10月7日高値と11月13日高値を結んだ上値抵抗線や下向きが続く転換線の58913円などが上値抵抗になりやすい。 上値メドには60000円の心理的節目や25日移動平均線の60579円などがあり、下値メドには5日移動平均線や57000円、11月20日安値の56436円などが挙げられている。
articles.summary_zh: 日经平均股价持续上涨。 虽然开盘买盘先行一度进入负值区间，但走势坚挺并进一步扩大涨幅，收盘时形成了收于接近最高价、突破10日移动平均线58643日元的阳线。 RSI（9日）从34.2%上升至39.3%，并超过了5日移动平均线的57660日元以及11月24日创下的收盘价基准反弹高点58644日元。 下周一方面期待延续11月9日以来的自主反弹走势，另一方面自10月上旬高点以来的价格调整仍在继续，由10月7日高点和11月13日高点连线延长的上方阻力线以及持续向下的转盘线58913日元等容易形成上方阻力。 上方目标位包括60000点的心理关口及25日移动平均线60579日元等，下方目标位则有5日移动平均线、57000日元、11月20日低点56436日元等。

articles.headline: Gold defies surging US Dollar and Treasury yields as bulls target $3,700
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) gained over 1.60% on Friday to trade at $3,633, heading toward its first weekly gain in three weeks despite rising US Treasury yields and a strong US Dollar. The recovery was driven by improved risk sentiment and profit-taking by bears. Meanwhile, US data confirmed inflation remains above the Federal Reserve's 2% goal, with the October Core PCE Price Index exceeding 3% and Q3 GDP growth hitting 4.3%. Markets price in a 99% chance of a 25-basis-point Fed rate hike in December. Physical gold demand also rose in Asian hubs, while central banks added 1,136 tonnes of gold worth around $70 billion to reserves in 2022.
articles.summary_zh: 金价（XAU/USD）在周五录得超过1.60%的坚实涨幅，交投于$3,633，有望打破两周连跌势头，尽管美国国债收益率上涨且美元走强。 贵金属的复苏归因于风险情绪改善以及空头获利了结。 同时，美国数据证实通胀仍高于美联储2%的目标，10月核心PCE物价指数超过3%，第三季度GDP增长率达到4.3%。 金融市场定价美联储在12月会议上加息25个基点的概率为99%。 此外，亚洲主要枢纽对实物黄金的需求上升，世界黄金协会数据显示2022年各国央行增持了1,136吨价值约$70 billion的黄金。

articles.headline: U.S. Stock Market Today, November 27, 2026: Tech Rebounds in Shortened Black Friday Session
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: U. S. stocks rebounded on Friday, November 27, 2026, in a shortened post-Thanksgiving session as investors stepped away from AI concerns. At the open, the Dow rose 275.9 points (0.55%) to 50,458.86, the S&P 500 gained 1.11% to 7,262.61, and the Nasdaq Composite added 1.58% to 23,958.46. In commodities, Brent crude reached $96.60 a barrel at 1239 GMT amid supply concerns from Strait of Hormuz tanker attacks and Saudi infrastructure strikes, while WTI hovered around $85.32. Spot gold traded near $3,649.60 an ounce (up $84.10 or 2.36%) and silver traded near $43.64 (up $2.23 or 5.37%) according to Kitco. Bitcoin traded near $62,000, rising over 2% in 24 hours.
articles.summary_zh: 在感恩节后的缩短交易日中，由于投资者暂时抛开对人工智能的担忧，美国股市于2026年11月27日周五反弹。 开盘时，道指上涨275.9点或0.55%至50,458.86，标普500指数上涨1.11%至7,262.61，纳斯达克综合指数上涨1.58%至23,958.46。 在大宗商品方面，受霍尔木兹海峡油轮袭击和沙特能源基础设施遭袭引发的供应担忧影响，格林威治标准时间12:39布伦特原油报$96.60每桶，WTI原油在$85.32左右。 Kitco数据显示，现货黄金交投于$3,649.60每盎司附近，上涨$84.10或2.36%，白银交投于$43.64附近，上涨约$2.23或5.37%。 比特币交易价格接近$62,000，24小时内上涨超过2%。

articles.headline: Why is the Japanese Yen weakening as calmer equity markets push US Treasury yields higher?
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Improving risk appetite on Friday supported a modest rise in USD/JPY, trading near 159.50 as calmer stock markets allowed US Treasury yields and the US Dollar to recover. The benchmark 10-year US Treasury yield rose to around 4.91% from Wednesday's 4.80% low, while the Japanese yield stood near 2.63%. The US Dollar Index (DXY) rose 0.13% to 103.93. Expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates further supported the dollar, with traders fully pricing in a December rate hike. In Japan, Tokyo core inflation excluding fresh food rose to 2.9% y/y in November, up from 2.6%, reaching its fastest pace since July 2025 according to analysts at Danske Bank.
articles.summary_zh: 周五风险胃纳的改善支撑美元兑日元小幅上涨，汇率交投于159.50附近，因股市企稳使得美债收益率和美元得以从近期科技股主导的抛售中恢复。 基准10年期美债收益率从周三触及的逾两个月低点4.80%回升至4.91%左右，日本相应收益率则在2.63%附近。 美元指数上涨0.13%至103.93。 美联储将进一步加息的预期支撑了美元，交易员已完全计入12月加息。 在日本，丹斯克银行分析师指出，11月东京扣除鲜食后的核心通胀率同比上涨至2.9%，高于前值的2.6%，创下2025年7月以来的最快增速。

articles.headline: Energy Aspects Expects Stockpiling to Support Oil Prices in 2027
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Energy Aspects founder and director Amrita Sen stated on Bloomberg TV that depleted inventories will drive a major stockpiling push in 2027, which will support oil prices despite an expected market surplus. China is expected to lead global stockpiling as it typically does when oil prices fall, alongside expanding storage capacity. Sen noted that supply risks from the Iran war have not eased much, leaving global buffers scarily thin. Saudi Aramco CEO Amin Nasser warned last month that nearly 3 billion barrels of gross oil supply were lost since the crisis began, leaving the supply resilience cushion extremely thin after starting with nearly 10 billion barrels of global oil stocks.
articles.summary_zh: Energy Aspects创始人兼董事阿米塔·森在彭博电视台表示，库存耗尽将在2027年推动大规模的囤货行动，尽管市场预计会出现过剩，但这将支撑油价。 中国预计将像以往油价下跌时那样主导全球囤货，同时扩大存储能力。 森指出，伊朗战争带来的供应风险并未大幅缓解，导致全球缓冲空间极其薄弱。 沙特阿美首席执行官阿明·纳赛尔上个月警告称，自危机爆发以来，近30亿桶的毛油供应已经损失，在以近100亿桶全球石油库存开局后，系统的供应韧性缓冲垫变得危险地薄。

articles.headline: Crypto Stocks Gain After Bitcoin Tops $61K In Tech Rebound, But Analysts Want A Move Above $62K
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: Large-cap crypto-linked stocks rose in early-morning trade on Friday as Bitcoin climbed above $61,000 alongside a tech futures rebound. Bitcoin rose 1.6% in 24 hours to around $61,600. Strategy (MSTR) gained over 6% in pre-market trade with bullish retail sentiment on Stocktwits. Tech-heavy Nasdaq futures rose 2.45% and S&P 500 futures gained 1.8%. Other gainers included Anthropic up 3.6%, Nvidia up 3.5%, Micron and SanDisk up over 9% each, and CipherDigital and CoreWeave up about 8% each. Silver jumped 7% to above $44 an ounce, gold gained 2.5% to above $3,670 an ounce, and WTI crude rose 2% to reclaim $85 a barrel. Crypto analysts Ted Pillows and Michael van de Poppe noted that Bitcoin needs to reclaim $62,000 for a rally toward $65,000 or higher targets.
articles.summary_zh: 随着比特币随科技期货反弹攀升至$61,000上方，大盘加密货币相关股票在周五早盘交易中上涨。 比特币在24小时内上涨1.6%，至$61,600左右。 Strategy（MSTR）在盘前交易中上涨逾6%，Stocktwits上的散户情绪呈看涨态势。 纳斯达克期货上涨2.45%，标普500期货上涨约1.8%。 其他上涨股票包括Anthropic上涨约3.6%，英伟达上涨约3.5%，美光和闪迪各自上涨超过9%，CipherDigital和CoreWeave各自上涨约8%。 白银价格跳涨7%至每盎司$44以上，黄金上涨2.5%至每盎司$3,670以上，WTI原油上涨2%收复$85每桶。 加密货币分析师泰德·皮洛斯和迈克尔·范·德·波佩指出，比特币需要收复$62,000才能向$65,000或更高目标发起反弹。

articles.headline: Japan Stocks Surge 1,212 Points on Friday as Technology Shares Rebound
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: On Friday, November 27, Japanese stocks rallied sharply, with the Nikkei 225 closing up 1,212 yen or 2.11% at 58,711 yen and the TOPIX rising 64.80 points to 3,815.20 as the Tokyo Stock Exchange closed at 3:30 p. m. Renewed buying in semiconductor and artificial intelligence-related shares drove the recovery, aided by rising U. S. Nasdaq futures. Advantest climbed 7.06% to 26,585 yen, Tokyo Electron advanced 4.43% to 8,220 yen, and SoftBank Group gained 3.12% to 2,984.5 yen. Prime Market turnover reached approximately 7.79 trillion yen on volume of 2.40 billion shares, with 926 advancing issues and 582 decliners.
articles.summary_zh: 在11月27日周五，日本股市大幅反弹，日经225指数收盘上涨1,212日元或2.11%，报58,711日元，东证指数上涨64.80点或1.73%，报3,815.20点。 半导体和人工智能相关股票的重新买入推动了基准指数从上周的跌势中复苏，午盘涨幅因美国纳斯达克期货上涨而扩大。 Advantest上涨7.06%至26,585日元，东京电子上涨4.43%至8,220日元，软银集团上涨3.12%至2,984.5日元。 东交所主板成交额达到约7.79 trillion，成交量为24.0亿股，上涨股票926只，下跌股票582只。

articles.headline: GBP Rises vs Yen as Markets Look Past Hot Tokyo CPI
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: The British Pound traded nearly 0.3% higher near 209.20 against the Japanese Yen during Friday's European session as the Yen lagged. Tokyo core CPI excluding fresh food rose 2.9% year-on-year in November, accelerating from 2.6% in October and reaching its fastest pace since July 2025, according to Danske Bank. While the increase was partly driven by the end of government utility subsidies, prices rose across a broad range of goods and services. The data supports expectations for a Bank of Japan rate hike at its December 17-18 meeting. Meanwhile, BoJ board member Naoki Tamura warned of inflation overshoot risks, and markets fully expect the Bank of England to deliver a 25 basis point rate hike to 4.25% on December 17.
articles.summary_zh: 周五欧洲交易时段，英镑兑日元上涨近0.3%，交投于209.20附近，日元表现滞后。 丹斯克银行指出，11月东京扣除鲜食后的核心CPI同比上涨2.9%，快于10月的2.6%，创下自2025年7月以来的最快增速。 尽管部分涨幅由政府公用事业补贴到期推动，但各类商品和服务价格均普遍上涨。 该数据支持了日本央行在12月17日至18日会议上加息的预期。 同时，日本央行审议委员田村直树警告了通胀超调的风险，市场则普遍预计英国央行将在12月17日加息25个基点至4.25%。

articles.headline: Dollar-Yen Holds Firm in Lower 159 Range, Supported by Stock Gains and Rising U.S. Yields
articles.section: 宏观经济与投资 / Macro & Investment
articles.summary: In the Tokyo foreign exchange market on the 27th, the dollar-yen held firm at 159.30-40 yen per dollar as of 5 p. m. , about 20 sen stronger for the dollar compared to the previous day. A sharp rise in the Nikkei Stock Average, which closed up 1,211.95 points at 58,711.11, and recovering U. S. long-term interest rates provided cues for dollar buying and yen selling. The November Tokyo metropolitan area core CPI excluding fresh food rose 2.9% year-on-year, missing the 3.1% market forecast and having limited immediate market impact. With U. S. markets having been closed on the 26th for Thanksgiving, overall trading activity remained thin, while the persistent Japan-U. S. interest rate differential sustained a dollar-buying tone.
articles.summary_zh: 在27日的东京外汇市场上，截至下午5点，美元兑日元汇率坚挺在159.30至159.40日元之间，较前一交易日同一时间美元走高约20钱。 日经平均指数收盘上涨1,211.95点，报58,711.11点，加上美国长期利率的回升，为买入美元和卖出日元提供了契机。 11月东京市区扣除鲜食后的核心CPI同比上涨2.9%，低于3.1%的市场预测，对市场的即时影响有限。 由于美国市场在26日因感恩节休市，整体交易活动保持清淡，而日美持续的利差则维持了买入美元的基调。
